yolo_imgsz.name: Pose inference resolution
yolo_imgsz.description: 480 (default) balances accuracy and CPU; 320 is fastest, 640 most detailed

leg_raise_margin.name: Leg-raise suppression margin
leg_raise_margin.description: Suppress gestures when ankle/knee rises this far above hip (0=disable)

snap_sustain_s.name: Snap hold time (s)
snap_sustain_s.description: Extra hold required after the arm is up. 0 with the flourish test, which fires at the top of the sweep

snap_require_rise.name: SNAP requires a rise
snap_require_rise.description: Legacy hold-style gate — only applies when 'Require a flourish' is off

snap_require_still.name: SNAP requires stillness
snap_require_still.description: Legacy hold-style gate — only applies when 'Require a flourish' is off

sustained_rearm_s.name: Pose re-arm time (s)
sustained_rearm_s.description: CROSS_ARMS/T_POSE/RAISE_BOTH fire once per pose; the pose must be released this long to fire again (default 2.0)

hand_crop_enable.name: Hand detection crop
hand_crop_enable.description: Run hand detection on a crop around the raised wrist — much better at couch distance (default on)

raise_elevation_min.name: Arm raise angle
raise_elevation_min.description: How far above horizontal an arm must point to count as raised (1.0 = straight up, 0.70 ~ 45 degrees). Works the same standing, sitting or lying down

arm_extension_min.name: Arm straightness
arm_extension_min.description: How straight the arm must be (1.0 = fully extended, 0.71 = elbow at 90 degrees) — rejects a hand held at your face

snap_elevation_min.name: Snap angle
snap_elevation_min.description: Minimum arm elevation for SNAP to fire. Raise above the arm raise angle to demand a straighter-up arm for firing (default 0.70)

min_arm_len_frac.name: Foreshortening guard
min_arm_len_frac.description: Refuse to judge an arm pointing nearly at the camera, where its projection is too short to read (default 0.55)

rise_elevation_delta.name: Minimum lift
rise_elevation_delta.description: How much the arm must climb to count as a deliberate lift when it starts already raised, e.g. from an armrest (default 0.35)

rise_start_elevation_max.name: Lowered-arm threshold
rise_start_elevation_max.description: An arm seen at or below this elevation counts as having started from a lowered position (default 0.35)

wrist_still_max_travel_arm.name: Stillness tolerance
wrist_still_max_travel_arm.description: How far the wrist may drift and still count as held, as a fraction of the arm's own length (default 0.15)

snap_require_flourish.name: Require a flourish
snap_require_flourish.description: Fire on the arm SWEEP — Endora's flourish — rather than on a raised arm held still. Also makes resting-arm false positives impossible. Turn off for the older hold-style gesture

flourish_min_climb.name: Flourish size
flourish_min_climb.description: How much the arm must climb during the sweep. A full down-to-up sweep is ~2.0; starting from an armrest, ~0.7 (default 0.60)

flourish_min_rate.name: Flourish speed
flourish_min_rate.description: How fast the sweep must be, in elevation per second. A resting arm is ~0, a deliberate flourish 2-3 (default 0.80)
